summary: Limited notice scope in criminal appeal; Article 136 jurisdiction; Article 142 powers; precedent analysis on expanding hearing scope; Taherakhatoon, Yomeshbhai Pranshankar Bhatt, Kutchi Lal Rameshwar Ashram Trust cited; Spring Meadows Hospital distinguished; substantial justice principle applied; conviction under IPC Sections 468/120B, 271/465/120B, 420/120B and PC Act Section 13(1)(d)/13(2) upheld; sentence: 2 years RI for most IPC offences, 1 year RI for Section 271/465/120B, 3 years RI under PC Act.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code, 1860 s.468, s.120B, s.271, s.465, s.420
Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 s.13(1)(d), s.13(2)
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; conviction and sentence upheld; limited notice scope not restricting full hearing under Article 142; substantial justice principle applied.
